state_history:
0: INIT -> OPEN_DEVICE | open video node if available
1: OPEN_DEVICE -> QUERYCAP | VIDIOC_QUERYCAP evidence collection
2: QUERYCAP -> FORMAT_NEGOTIATION | simulate OUTPUT/CAPTURE S_FMT and record requested formats
3: FORMAT_NEGOTIATION -> BUFFER_SETUP | simulate REQBUFS/QUERYBUF/MMAP for both queues
4: BUFFER_SETUP -> STREAMING | simulate STREAMON both queues
5: STREAMING -> RUNNING | enter QBUF/poll/DQBUF loop with counters and fault injection
6: RUNNING -> RECOVERY | STREAMOFF both queues and requeue after timeout
7: RECOVERY -> RUNNING | return to decode loop after timeout recovery
8: RUNNING -> DRAINING | send EOS and continue DQBUF until LAST
9: DRAINING -> STOPPED | STREAMOFF both queues and release buffers
